name: kdgame3
caption:
45.3 SECONDS LEFT 🎮🏀 Game 3 of the 2017 Finals, in Cleveland. Kevin Durant pulls up.

• June 7, 2017: we already led the series 2-0
• KD's go-ahead three with 45.3 seconds left
• We win 118-113 to go up 3-0
• KD: 31 points, 9 rebounds
• Title in 5 games, and KD is Finals MVP

Biggest shot of the KD era? 👇

facts.claim: 2017 Finals: Durant helped the Warriors go up 3-0 in the series (already 2-0 after Game 2) with a 31-point effort in Game 3 (June 7, 2017 at Cleveland), including the go-ahead 3-pointer with 45.3 seconds left; Game 5 series-clinching win (title in 5 games); 2017 Finals MVP
